in_sanskrit.name: Adhit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Leader, Ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Adhit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Adhit is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'adh' which means 'to rule' or 'to lead'. The name is associated with gods like Indra and Vishnu, who are often referred to as the rulers of the universe. Adhit is a powerful name, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and the ability to guide and protect.
